name: Suspicious Birch-Steamed Pork Ribs
desc: A dish made with branches and ribs. You casually take a piece, only to find it deep reddish-brown from drying, with lines across its surface like the rings of an old tree. Add in that coarse texture, and... Hold on. Surely this is not a branch mistaken for a rib?

value.text: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
